entries.name: OracleMind
entries.screening_reason: Policy v9 benchmark answer replacement. On the served path, src/baseline.rs:1876-1887 checks whether a completed model reply contains a derived ordering/duration value and, when it does not, replaces the reply with a code-composed ANSWER line. That line is then lifted into the authoritative scoring slot. This is content-conditioned positive-answer synthesis, not an empty-generation fallback or model-authored grounding. No copying allegation is made.

entries.name: bunny
entries.screening_reason: Policy v9 benchmark answer replacement. The served memory path classifies fixed benchmark-shaped request families and, after model execution, overwrites the model reply using deterministic parsers tailored to generator phrasing. This covers ordering, recurring counts, elapsed durations, update chains, code/PIN near-misses, relational joins, filtered counts, recommendations, and preferences; it also removes planted tokens post-generation. This is scorer manipulation, not retrieval assistance.
